- [LTES.3.2.4] **Side-effect determinism.** Stepping the clock by `Δt`
  triggers all time-dependent side effects that would have
  fired in that interval on a real clock: tick re-evaluation
  for time-bound `logical` LHS tests, `after`-timer fact
  retractions, `cooldown` expiry, `retain` expiry, series-
  window slides. Stepping is atomic with respect to rule
  fires — the engine finishes one step's cascade before
  reporting the step complete.
